relationships.subject: UVB
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed dose-dependent increases in the skin starting at 0.144 J/cm2 UVB (Figure 3A).

relationships.subject: anti-VEGF antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal administration of 2C3 decreases blood vessel dilation (Figure 3B), reduces edema as shown by 50% decrease in ear thickness (Figure 3C)

relationships.subject: sorafenib
relationships.evidence_quote: Topical administration of sorafenib, a small molecule VEGFR-2 tyrosine kinase inhibitor, similarly reduced mouse-ear thickness caused by UVB exposure (Figure 3E).

relationships.subject: UVB
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, these results suggest VEGF signaling is activated within 5 hours of UV exposure in humans.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: UVB and inflammatory mediator PGE2 directly upregulate VEGF in human dermal fibroblasts and indirectly elevate VEGF in human epidermal keratinocytes46.

key_findings: VEGF/VEGFR-2 signaling is activated immediately after UV exposure (VEGFR-2 Y1175 phosphorylation at 5 h in human skin; VEGF mRNA induced in mice).
Systemic or topical VEGF pathway inhibition (2C3, GNP-anti-VEGF, sorafenib) post-UVB reduced edema and vascular changes in mice.
